evidence.observation: Pressure at 2.903 Torr at the start of growth, matching the steady ~2.90 Torr seen during the ramp at 100 sccm Ar
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.184 Torr (about +0.07 Torr every 120 s) with no setpoint change
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by extra inflow
Thermocouple at the 750 °C setpoint after a 760 °C overshoot at 2520 s
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so air ingress cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: To tell an air leak (seal_leak) from a restricted exhaust (exhaust_blockage), we need an exhaust O2 reading or a discriminating test: a rate-of-rise test with the tube isolated, or a check of the exhaust line and valve conductance.
